_comment: Text/surface pairs (by CSS custom-property name) that are below WCAG AA 4.5:1 on the current palette. The contrast audit WARNs instead of failing for these so the gate can be adopted while the Barrier Island Digital palette is rolled out. The BID-aligned 'text-faint' role (--color-text-tertiary) is decorative-only by design; the planned PR-2 consumer migration to --color-text-secondary where it is used as body text must REMOVE this pair as it raises the contrast. Format: pairs is an array of [textTokenName, surfaceTokenName].
